name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into farmer bank accounts.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names. Exclusions: Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, serving/retired government employees, income-tax payers, pensioners with monthly pension >₹10,000.
application_guidance: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration) or via local Common Service Centre (CSC) or District Agriculture Officer. Required: Aadhaar card, updated land record (Khata/Khatian/RoR), Aadhaar-linked active bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, pest/disease attack, post-harvest losses). Farmers pay nominal premium: 2% for Kharif food & oilseeds, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers, tenant farmers, loanee, and non-loanee farmers.
application_guidance: Enroll through bank branch, PMFBY Portal (pmfby.gov.in), CSC, or authorized insurance company representative before seasonal cut-off date (usually July 31 for Kharif, Dec 31 for Rabi). Required: Sowing certificate, land record/lease agreement, Aadhaar, bank passbook.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefits: Concessional institutional short-term credit up to ₹3.00 lakh at effective interest rate of 4% per annum (7% base rate with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Also covers post-harvest expenses, animal husbandry, and fisheries up to ₹2.00 lakh.
eligibility: Individual/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, SHGs, and JLGs.
application_guidance: Apply at any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch, or online through JanSamarth portal. Documents: Application form, Land Records/RoR, Identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Pan card.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Medium-long term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. 3% per annum interest subvention up to ₹2 crore loan for a maximum period of 7 years, along with CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Agri-entrepreneurs, Start-ups, SHGs, JLGs, and Central/State agencies.
application_guidance: Apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal. Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR), land records/lease, KYC, and select lending bank. Online approval workflow.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Financial subsidy up to 55% for Small & Marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installation of Micro Irrigation Systems (Drip and Sprinkler irrigation).
eligibility: All landholding farmers with assured irrigation water source. Priority given to water-stressed blocks, small/marginal farmers, and SC/ST farmers.
application_guidance: Apply through State Horticulture/Agriculture portal or District Horticulture Office. Requires: Land records (7/12 / RoR), Aadhaar card, bank passbook, quotation from empanelled micro-irrigation manufacturer.

name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation)
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
benefits: Financial assistance for small & marginal farmers for cultivation inputs and livelihood assistance of ₹12,500 for landless agricultural households, along with life and accidental insurance cover.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural laborers, and vulnerable agricultural households of Odisha.
application_guidance: Apply via kalia.odisha.gov.in or through Gram Panchayat nodal officer. Required: Aadhaar card, ration card, land record / proof of landless laborer status, active bank account.

name: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
benefits: Direct investment support per acre per season for purchase of seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, labor, and other field operations directly into farmer accounts.
eligibility: Pattadar passbook holder farmers and eligible tenant farmers of Telangana with verified land records.
application_guidance: Verified through Dharani land records portal and Agriculture Extension Officers (AEOs). Requires: Pattadar Passbook, Aadhaar card, IFSC-linked bank account.
